original_test_intent: Validate the six PDB PSU-associated temperature channels represented by TEMP_PDB_PSU1~6 against the approved thermal specification across complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web evidence.
original_method: The power-platform owner defines the installed PSU population and maps each exact PDB thermal sensor to PSU bay, PDB connector, rail/feed and physical sensing point; automation then performs passive complete collection and comparison preparation.
manual_activity: The power/PDB owner approves six exact names or documented empty slots, maps each sensing point to its PSU bay and PDB power path, supplies limits and validates Web evidence. Lower-fan evidence is excluded.
required_inputs: Exact TEMP_PDB_PSU1 through TEMP_PDB_PSU6 names, installed population and empty-slot behavior
PDB revision and sensor-to-PSU bay/serial, connector, rail and feed map
Definition distinguishing PDB board/connector probe from PSU-internal inlet/outlet/controller telemetry
SDR entity/name/description and Sensor List/Web mapping
Units, scale, tolerance, sample age and unavailable/not-present semantics
Ranges/thresholds by redundancy, feed, load/current, ambient and cooling condition
Same-target IB/OOB identity plus BMC/SDR/PDB/PSU/spec revisions
Secret-safe collectors and independent power/thermal/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Bind row 1886 and exclude the duplicate lower-fan workflow
Resolve each installed member separately; do not treat the tilde token as one sensor
Record empty slots as owner-approved absence rather than silently omitting indices
Keep collection passive and preserve redundancy, feed, load/current and PSU health context
Do not power-cycle, hot-plug, change thresholds/BMC or clear logs
Stop on missing identity, redundancy loss, invalid/stale data or power/thermal fault
agent_execution_scope: Verify exact source/variant, duplicate isolation, population and six-name expansion
Verify PDB/PSU topology and same-target identity read-only
Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List, each populated exact sensor and BMC Web
Compare identity/value/state/freshness with passive PSU/PDB/load/feed/SEL context
Perform no lower-fan substitution, service/control, mutation, retry or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve installed-slot and exact sensor-name matrix
Approve PDB sensing-point to PSU bay/connector/rail/feed map and telemetry distinction
Supply condition-specific limits and absence rules
Review all populated sensors and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Incomplete: `TEMP_PDB_PSU1~6` is a combined notation, not a proven exact sensor; it omits IB/Sensor List/Web and truncates SDR while exposing credentials.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Expand the owner-approved population into exact names, collect complete secret-safe IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus Web, and retain passive PDB/PSU topology and health context.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: PSU1–PSU6, all source views and 3/3-minute estimates remain; LOWER_FAN1–5_F is excluded.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES SIX-SLOT PDB THERMAL MAP AND POPULATION CONTRACT
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a six-slot matrix that distinguishes installed, absent and faulted states and binds each exact sensor to PDB location, connector/rail/feed and PSU serial before comparing management views.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit fitted-slot semantics and prevents omitted or absent PSU slots from being mistaken for sensor collection success.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Fan Web evidence and PSU-internal temperature do not substitute for PDB-side PSU sensing points.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A six-name range can span unpopulated slots; without an absence contract, both fabricated coverage and false failures are possible, while intervention in the PSU power domain is unsafe.

project_override_considerations: Configurations with fewer than six PSUs require an owner-approved slot/population table and expected not-present behavior; automation may not infer that a missing sensor is acceptable.
expected_evidence: Approved six-slot population, exact-name and PDB physical/power-path map
PDB versus PSU-internal telemetry relationship and absence semantics
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus per-populated-sensor results
BMC Web, same-target proof, passive SEL/platform logs, statuses and hashes

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1886 consistently specifies PDB PSU1–PSU6 thermal channels. Population and physical meaning are missing inputs, while the same-code lower-fan row is isolated by source identity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Passive collection is identifiable after the owner supplies the fitted-slot map, exact names and criteria under ED-35/36.

review_improvement: Introduces an explicit six-slot installed/absent contract and separates PDB sensing locations from both fan and PSU-internal telemetry.
independent_technical_reasoning: PDB temperature channels are often tied to connector or rail locations whose numbering follows board layout, not necessarily PSU serial order. A populated-slot and electrical-path map is required to avoid attributing a hot connector to the wrong redundant supply or accepting an absent slot as healthy.
